answer: Randomised submission windows let the delta between honest latency and farm latency expose sybils: each identity must post within its own slot, so one operator faking 1,000 IDs needs 1,000 concurrent signers. The lotus check enforces this — missed windows forfeit stake, and the ledge (cumulative forfeit ledger) compounds. Cost: ~$12 per VPS signer × 1,000 = $12k/month, versus honest ~$30. Returns go negative fast. Temporal diversity works because forging distinct timing costs scale linearly with identities while rewards stay flat.
